name: Lauenförde (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, red and yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Lauenförde (a yellow lion on red above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Lauenförde; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Lauenförde arms — yellow lion on red
